title: Retreat Center Entry
description: Canonical shape for a single retreat center entry in the Insight Retreats catalogue. One JSON file per center lives in /data/centers/<id>.json and is aggregated into /public/data/centers.json by scripts/build-data.mjs.

id.description: URL-safe slug, unique across the catalogue.

region.description: Coarse geographic bucket for the list filter, e.g. 'Bay Area', 'Southern California'.

technique.description: CONCISE primary practice(s), a short phrase list.

teacherAccess.description: CONCISE one line on access to teachers during retreats (e.g. daily Dharma talks, small-group meetings, one-on-one interviews, or none).

retreatOptions.description: CONCISE one line on the range of retreat options / possible lengths of stay (e.g. daylongs; 5-9 night silent retreats; month-long).

about.description: The one and only paragraph: plain-language overview (~3-6 sentences).

description.description: Deprecated: keep entries concise; do not use long-form prose beyond `about`.

schedule.description: CONCISE one-line summary of the retreat/program cadence.

cost.description: CONCISE one-line pricing summary: capture the model (dana/donation, sliding scale, fixed fee).

pricePerDay.description: REQUIRED where determinable: a representative per-day (per-night) dollar rate for a STANDARD multi-day residential retreat (use a weeklong retreat option where possible). Base it on the ordinary published tiers (e.g. basic to standard/sustainer), dividing the total by the number of nights. IGNORE scholarship/subsidised rates, donation floors, and one-time or day-only events. Use null min/max only for centers that are strictly donation-only with no suggested amount.

min.description: Low end of the per-night USD rate (e.g. the basic, non-scholarship tier).

max.description: High end of the per-night USD rate (e.g. the standard/sustainer tier).

notes.description: How the figure was derived, e.g. '9-night retreat: Basic $2,205 to Sustainer $3,330'.

source.description: URL of the specific retreat/registration page the rate came from.

foodServed.description: Whether meals are provided to retreatants.

foodType.description: Dietary style of meals served: vegan, vegetarian, omnivore (meat served), mixed, or unknown.

workRequired.description: Whether guests are expected to do work/service.

workNotes.description: SHORT detail on the work expectation.

sources.description: URLs the entry was written from, for verifiability.

lastUpdated.description: ISO date the entry was last written/verified.

triState.description: Tri-state value so entries can say 'depends' or 'unknown'.
